summary_1line: Rama meets his grief-stricken father Dasharatha, refuses the throne, and insists on honoring the exile decree despite the king’s desperate pleas.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasharatha rushes toward Rama with his queens but collapses unconscious to the floor before reaching him.
Rama and Lakshmana lift the fainted king while hundreds of palace women cry out 'Rama, Rama' in a hall filled with lamentation.
Rama stands calmly before the grieving king and queens, declaring he will enter the forest while Sita and Lakshmana stand beside him.
